newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish coal mining sector losses double after Q1.
newsitem.headline: Polish coal mining sector losses double after Q1.

text.p: Losses recorded by the Polish coal mining industry almost doubled in the first quarter of 1997 against the same period last year to 491 million zlotys, a report by the Rzeczpospolita daily said.
The state-owned sector's losses are likely to continue mounting even faster in the coming months due to an expected fall in hard coal sales in summer, the newspaper said.
It gave no sources for the quoted figures and no one at the economy ministry overseeing the sector was immediately avaliable for comment.
The paper said that to retain financial liquidity coal mines increased their output which led to more fierce competition and a lowering of prices, again worsening the industry's situation.
At the beginning of 1997 the sector's debts exceeded 10 billion zlotys.
